description: Lists what this site has changed in its published Australian retirement figures since a date, such as new or corrected values, earlier values added and figures added or renamed. Newest first. since filters on recorded_on, the date this site recorded the change, in Sydney. effective_from is the date the changed value applies from, where the change has one. A value can be recorded long after it began to apply.

limit.description: The most changes to return. Default 25, maximum 100.

since.description: Return changes recorded on or after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD. This is the date the change was recorded, not the date a value applies from.

name: list_changes

data_release.description: The number of the data release these values come from.

effective_from.description: The date the value applies from, where the change has one.

preview.description: True only on a test build, for a change that is not yet published.

recorded_on.description: The date this site recorded the change, in Sydney.

scope.description: What this site does and does not provide.

truncated.description: True when there are more items than this result holds.

title: List changes
